question.text: A trader buys 5 lots of USDINR futures at 83.00. The contract closes at 83.50. What is the trader's profit?

explanation.text: The Logic: Profit = (Close - Entry) x Lot size x Number of lots = (83.50 - 83.00) x 1000 x 5 = 0.50 x 5000 = Rs. 2,500. The USDINR lot size is 1000 USD and a long futures position profits when prices rise. The Trap: The calculation must multiply by both lot size (1000 USD) and the number of lots (5); omitting either gives the wrong answer. Note: A 1 paisa move in USDINR equals Rs. 10 per lot (0.01 x 1000), so a 50 paise move equals Rs. 500 per lot.
